capabilities: Highlight CQL code blocks with tokens for fields, functions, keywords, operators, strings, regexes, and comments
Accept logscale as an alias language for code blocks
Render highlighting through the native code-block pipeline in reading mode, Live Preview, and source mode
Color tokens using the theme's code variables
Ship ready-to-use hunting query templates for process, network, and identity hunts
extras: Includes a templates/ folder with sample hunting queries (process-hunting.cql, network-hunting.cql, identity-hunting.cql); README links to external CQL and LogScale references.
intentEvidence: No equivalent plugin exists in the Obsidian community.
motivation: The README notes no equivalent plugin exists for threat hunters who document playbooks, runbooks, and DFIR notes in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no syntax highlighting for CQL, so threat hunters documenting LogScale queries get uncolored plain-text code blocks.
summary: Syntax highlighting plugin that colors CrowdStrike CQL (LogScale Query Language) code blocks in editing and reading modes.
